description: Runs a shell command in an isolated one-shot sandbox and returns stdout, stderr and the exit code (Daytona ExecuteRequest/ExecuteResponse compatible) Price: $0.002 a call (3 free calls a day without an API key).

command.description: The shell command to run (up to 64 KB)

cwd.description: Working directory, relative to the run's work directory

env.description: Environment variables; keys must match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* (Daytona's rule)

files.description: Text files written into the work directory before the run (up to 50, 1 MB each, 4 MB total)

outputs.description: Relative paths to read back after the run (up to 20); up to 1 MB each comes back base64 in outputFiles, larger in tooLargeOutputs, absent in missingOutputs

timeout.description: Run timeout in seconds, 1-120 (default 60); a timed-out run answers exitCode 124

name: execute-command
title: Runs a shell command in an isolated one-shot sandbox and returns stdout, stderr
